source_scope.source_state: exact content-addressed historical parameter, optimizer, gradient, task-input and validation-input objects

execution_scope.gate_site: component output after its output projection and before residual addition

baseline_gate.required_current_runtime_equality: raw float32 decision-logit bytes, predictions and capability must be exactly equal between repetitions
baseline_gate.historical_comparison: record historical raw-logit hash equality, prediction equality, capability equality and maximum absolute logit error
baseline_gate.reason: the historical experiment did not preserve its CUDA driver/kernel environment; v2 is a new real analysis execution from exact historical checkpoint states and does not claim to reproduce the unpreserved historical kernel
baseline_gate.mixing_rule: all baseline, gated and derived v2 quantities at a checkpoint must come from the same current runtime; historical logits are audit-only and never enter a support calculation

target_mapping.source: derived from exact training input/target facts as linear constraints over the prime field F_23
target_mapping.admission: rank 22, nullity 1, observed training targets exactly reproduced, and the completed token operation table invariant under every nonzero field scalar
target_mapping.native_cross_check: when an explicit historical validation-target object exists, it must equal the derived target tensor element for element
target_mapping.provenance: the derivation is a new analysis occurrence with GeneratedOrigin links to the exact training inputs, training targets and validation inputs; it is not relabelled as a native training fact

margin.per_example: true-target decision logit minus maximum non-target decision logit, preserving validation row order
margin.target_group: linear-interpolation 0.10 quantile of per-example margins for each of the 23 derived target-token groups
margin.complete_payloads: all decision logits, predictions, per-example margins and group memberships are stored content-addressed

derived_definitions.effective_support: Q_kt=1/sum_j(w_jkt^2), w_jkt=N_jkt/sum_j(N_jkt); zero total necessity produces ExplicitDisposition
derived_definitions.component_optimizer_load: for parameter version t, derive RMS Adam first moment, square-root mean Adam second moment and parameter RMS from exact source objects; derive clipped-gradient RMS only when the exact payload from producing training-loop index t-1 is materialized, otherwise preserve its exact object identities and form ExplicitDisposition rather than borrowing the differently indexed materialized gradient at t

generation_fact_model.identity_rule: equal numeric values do not collapse objects, occurrences or facts
generation_fact_model.zero_effect_rule: a real byte-identical gated output retains its distinct occurrence and records ZERO_EFFECT_OBSERVED
